title.zh: SmartLingo Max 实时语音导师与学习语言分离
title.en: SmartLingo Max live voice tutor and independent learning language

purpose.zh: 让旗舰版学习者以已选目标语言直接进入一对一导师，用网站语言获得必要解释，并在每日限时内使用可打断的实时语音和动画虚拟人物；修复 Safari 朗读无声却显示播放的问题。
purpose.en: Open the selected learning language directly in Max, use the site language for support, add interruptible time-limited live voice with an animated virtual tutor, and fix Safari's false read-aloud playback state.

zh: Max 实时 WebRTC 双向语音接入现有 AI 网关，配合响应声音的动画虚拟人物；文字导师继续可用。
实时语音沿用试用每日 10 分钟、付费每日 30 分钟额度；服务器预留、挂断、过期清理及未用时长退回，并在会员到期时终止通话。
快捷版和旗舰版统一称为“我的学习语言”；切换网站语言保留学习目标和页面参数，进入一对一导师时默认使用已选语言。
Safari 朗读改为点击时直接启动、保留语音对象，只有实际开始播放才显示计时；无声启动失败会提示重试。
en: Add bidirectional WebRTC voice through the existing AI gateway with a speech-reactive animated virtual tutor; keep the text tutor available.
Share the trial's 10-minute and paid Max's 30-minute daily tutor allowance with server reservation, hangup, expiry cleanup and refund of unused time.
Label Flash and Max tiles as learning languages, preserve the target across site-language switches, and open the selected language directly in the one-to-one tutor.
Start Safari read-aloud synchronously from the tap, retain the utterance, show playback only after speech actually starts, and report silent startup failures.

zh: 快捷版和旗舰版语言卡片、Max 导师页面、Ask Guru 朗读、实时语音 API、定时清理及新通话数据表。
en: Flash and Max language tiles, Max tutor page, Ask Guru read-aloud, live voice API, scheduled cleanup, and a new call table.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 现有 AI 网关、Max 权限及学习计划表；保留数据重建导师会话表以支持十二种网站语言，新增带唯一活动通话约束的 D1 表和每分钟清理，课堂维护仍为每五分钟。
en: Reuse the existing AI gateway, Max entitlement, and learning plans; rebuild the tutor-session table while preserving rows to allow twelve site languages, then add a D1 call table with a single-active-call constraint and minute cleanup while class maintenance remains five-minute.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、全量测试、D1 迁移重放、构建和共享站点检查；上线后用真实浏览器验证匿名与会员流程及精确发布记录。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, D1 migration replay, build and shared-site gates; then real-browser anonymous/member checks and exact release-record verification.

zh: 虚拟人物为随音量变化的动画，并非真人摄像视频或逐音素口型同步；不保存原始音频。不会提交真实付款。
en: The virtual character is a speech-reactive animation, not live human video or phoneme-accurate lip sync; raw audio is not stored. No real payment is submitted.

zh: 学习语言与十二种网站语言独立；以现有 Max 七天试用和付费权限控制语音，导师明确披露 AI 身份。
en: Keep the learning target independent of all twelve site languages; gate voice by the existing seven-day trial and paid Max entitlement, and disclose AI identity.

rollback.zh: 此迁移复制并保留旧导师会话数据后重建表的语言约束，同时新增实时通话表与时长结算触发器。可回退应用代码，但数据库结构不得直接逆转；如需回退结构，先备份并单独审查迁移。
rollback.en: This migration copies and preserves existing tutor sessions while rebuilding their language constraint, and adds the live-call table and settlement trigger. Application code can be rolled back, but the schema must not be reversed directly; back up and review any future schema rollback separately.
